card.text: Explore Hati, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Cassini measured a 5.45-hour rotation period and substantial brightness variations for Hati. This ellipsoid illustrates its minimum elongation with assumed polar depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.42:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
